create_Scannet3DEvaluator: create a Scannet3DEvaluator instance for evaluating 3D semantic instance segmentation on ScanNet datasets
process_evaluation_batch: process a batch of inputs and model outputs to accumulate ground truth and prediction metrics for 3D evaluation
evaluate_results: evaluate accumulated predictions and ground truths across distributed workers and return mAP results
reset_evaluator_state: reset the evaluator state by clearing accumulated ground truth, predictions, and score buffers
parse_ground_truth: parse multi-frame ground truth instances into 3D point-level format for semantic instance evaluation
